instructions: Fresh review of each primary candidate: read dialogue first, then exact cards. Assess all six unchanged criteria and all coach-2.0 gates with turn-specific evidence. For pairs, show whether the Stance changes HOW A pursues the Drive in one interaction. Do not invent missing backstory or assume prior approval. Use the alternate only to assess meaningful differentiation. Report actual reservations. No writer scores or improvement claims are supplied.
productionStandard:
PRODUCTION STANDARD coach-2.0. Historical coach-1.0 acceptance is not coach-2.0 acceptance. Read the dialogue first and record what the spoken words establish before interpreting the card. Exact cards are already in this invocation: label internal-dialogue-first, never blind or human review. Do not invent a charitable backstory; harmless unspecified names/history are not defects. Fill coach2 for ORIGINAL dialogue in writer output and CANDIDATE dialogue in reviewer output. Copy the supplied dialogue hash for the text being assessed. Give concise actual turn evidence, not generic claims.
G1: legible immediate situation, wants/stakes; separate stated, ordinary inferred, and missing essentials. Identify first material defect or explicitly none.
G2: coherent facts, ownership, timing, language, knowledge; recognizable misunderstanding/revelation is allowed, unstated intervening events are not.
G3: assess all A1-B2, B2-A3, A3-B4, B4-A5 links. Vocabulary repetition alone is insufficient. Purposeful avoidance must read as behavior.
G4: B is a plausible participant with an intelligible practical/emotional position, not a contrived punchline cue. B can help, concede or solve.
G5: exact card changes A's choices. For pairs Stance changes HOW A pursues Drive and B responds to the merged behavior; neither card may be decorative.
G6: ending develops the same behavior using B4. Investigate if A5 would work after unrelated B4; more obstacles are not required for heightening.
format: five spoken ABABA turns, existing word/schema limit, no narration/coaching/truncation.
Every mandatory gate and transition is PASS, FAIL or UNCLEAR with evidence; UNCLEAR cannot be accepted. All gates pass AND total >=85 AND fidelity/response >=4 AND others >=3; preserve the six weights 30/20/15/15/10/10. A 5 is not merely presence. Totals are derived in code. Retain good originals; no rewrite quota. Review both alternatives for different tactics, relationships or pressure. Scene outline identifies roles, task, A want, B want, stakes, exact-card tactic and B's contribution; it is private planning evidence, not a substitute for missing spoken facts. Humour must come from sincere priorities and responsive choices, not stock hierarchy or unrelated slogans. Record actual weaknesses and reservations. Writer corrections target only rejected/materially changed scenes; preserve all accepted records and prior original assessments exactly. No coach-1.0 failure or exhausted allowance is erased by this separately versioned cycle.

cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Basically Finished
cards.instruction: Describe incomplete, late, or improvised work as a thoughtful version of completion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your cupboard is complete in its adjustable configuration. Please don't wedge the shelves in; that defeats the design.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They fall down. You haven't fitted the supports.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Supports fix a height. We establish your preferred layout before making irreversible decisions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I paid for installation, not loose wood. Here's the drill.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll install one shelf at your chosen height. A completed reference shelf, please, not 'one shelf done.' You can approve the rest against it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The budget report is finished. Title page only; please don't mistake a concise executive format for an omission.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The board meets in ten minutes. Where are the figures?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: This edition lets them supply figures without being anchored by mine. Leave the white space; it's functional.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They want your recommendation, not a workshop.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then add 'Approve' beneath the title. Now it is a complete decision paper. One word, please; we mustn't bury the recommendation.

cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: I’ve Done This Before
cards.instruction: Perform calm familiarity with the task while learning how it works from every new clue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll make your coffee. I know this machine. Cup under the outlet, please; this button starts the cycle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's steam. Coffee's behind the flap.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. Open the flap before selecting coffee, not after. Keep the cup centred under the outlet.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It makes two cups unless you turn that dial. I only want one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. Turn the dial to one before pressing the coffee button. I'll press it; we don't need two operators for one cup.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll have this tent up before the rain. Feed the pole through the sleeve carefully; forcing fabric is how beginners tear it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There aren't sleeves. It's clips, after the poles cross.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, the clip system. Cross first, attach second. Please keep that order while I position the fabric.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's the outer cover. We're standing on the inner tent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Inner first, then the weather layer. Step off it, please; I can't demonstrate the sequence while you're pinning it to the ground.

cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Outdo the Effort
cards.instruction: Answer every favor, chore, or sacrifice with a bigger one that restores your lead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You brought soup? I'll prepare your dinners for a week. Label portions by date, please; guessing isn't meal planning.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're ill. I've already filled your freezer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then when I'm up, I'll fill yours for a month. Properly portioned; we won't waste your space on half-empty tubs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine's tiny. Just return the tubs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Send me the measurements for a bigger freezer. Height, width and depth, please. I'll return your tubs full inside it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thanks for the lift. I'll cover your Saturday shift. Send a proper handover, please, not a list of first names.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: No need. I covered yours yesterday so you could rest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll take your whole weekend. Exact start and finish times; I don't leave people half-covered.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've already swapped Sunday so I can drive you to the airport.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll cancel the flight and cover your entire holiday. Send every date, including travel days. We cover the absence, not just the nights in a hotel.

cards.title: Efficiency Win
cards.instruction: Celebrate each inconvenience as proof that a faster, cheaper, or smarter routine can now be invented.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The lift's broken. Excellent: cancel the gym and take the stairs. Use a steady pace, please; this is conditioning, not a sprint.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We live eight floors up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A complete session built into the journey home. Recover on each landing, not halfway across a step.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: And the shopping? I'm carrying six bags.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect, resistance work included. Let me balance the weight between your hands. Bags down at each landing, please; that's your recovery interval.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The dishwasher's broken. Excellent: curry in bread rolls, no plates. Slice horizontally, please; we need a base, not a sandwich slit.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We have six rolls and twelve guests.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then both halves become dishes. Equal depth, please. Twice the service from the same bread.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The curry will run off the flat halves.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Better still: hollow them without breaking the crust. Stir the crumbs into the curry. Gently, please; our thickener mustn't cost us the bowls.

cards.title: No Trouble at All
cards.instruction: Remain gracious and accommodating while making your growing inconvenience impossible to miss.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course your brother can stay. Serve him my pie on a warm plate, please; an extra guest gets the same standard.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You haven't eaten either.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Peas will do for me. A warm bowl, not an empty dinner plate; we needn't make the portion look any smaller.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll order you a pizza. It will take forty minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: How kind. Serve everyone else now, please, not when mine arrives. I'll keep my place laid while I watch them finish.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll carry your book bag to the platform. Zip it fully, please; the books belong inside it, not on the stairs. My shoulder can manage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's full of dictionaries. Let me take it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No, keep the tickets flat for the scanner. I'll change shoulders at the bottom; it's only the one staircase.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They've moved us to platform twelve, across the bridge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Check for a lift before choosing more stairs, please. I'll carry it across either way; my other shoulder has had almost a minute's rest.
